questions: Trace report normalization, validation checkpoints and deterministic acceptance outside worker claims.
Check missing evidence-packet path in the concise prompt and stagnation fingerprints.
decision: Make acceptance depend on pinned deterministic validation evidence and ensure the production prompt exposes the allowed evidence packet.
code_observations: Production runner_contract.worker_prompt calls failure_context without the plan directory, so the inspected path does not include the available evidence-packet pointer.
Worker completion reports, runner validations and resumable validation checkpoints are distinct. Passing report schema checks alone is not product acceptance.
implementation_steps: Pass the correct plan directory through the composed prompt path and explicitly permit only the assigned evidence packet and bounded relevant diagnostic artifacts.
Pin validation receipts to command, source state, resource-map digest and attempt/job identity. Reuse a successful receipt only when the inputs are still current.
Keep failure classification deterministic where evidence is explicit. Record environmental faults and test time limits separately from semantic code failures.
Sanitize diagnostic data before truncation and preserve machine-readable evidence references so a new worker can inspect facts without the whole history.
Add negative tests where a worker claims success but output behavior, a negative case or an integration contract fails. The runner must keep the task incomplete.
proposed_acceptance_tests: The composed prompt contains a valid evidence-packet pointer after a failed validation.
A changed source/map/command invalidates a previously successful receipt.
A valid success JSON with failing tests cannot complete the task.
A repeated failure fingerprint is stable under timestamps/PIDs but changes for a genuinely different failure.
A resumed completed worker checkpoint validates without unnecessary model redispatch.

alternatives.title: Trust worker validation declarations
alternatives.tradeoff: Cheapest apparent path, but it can accept unobserved or stale success.

alternatives.title: Pinned independent receipts and task-local evidence pointers
alternatives.tradeoff: Low token overhead with falsifiable acceptance.

alternatives.title: Paste every historical report/log into each retry
alternatives.tradeoff: Expensive, privacy-sensitive and likely to anchor the next worker on stale diagnosis.

cost_model: Avoid repeating model implementation when only validation remains. Measure tests rerun, stale receipts rejected and incorrect completion prevented; do not treat fewer tests as an optimization by itself.
unverified: A narrow unit suite does not prove end-user quality. Real integration/environment coverage must be declared rather than implied.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
